title: Solvation-Mediated Effects of Contact Mutations on p53-DNA Binding Dynamics and Energetics.
authors: Gaikwad, Vikram; Venugopal, Pushyaraga P; Chakrabarti, Rajarshi
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过原子级MD模拟和自由能计算，系统研究了p53转录因子接触突变对DNA结合动力学、能量学及界面水合网络的影响，精准契合TF-DNA互作机制建模课题。
abstract: The tumor suppressor protein p53 is a sequence-specific transcription factor whose DNA-binding domain (DBD) is essential for maintaining genomic stability. Mutations at residues that directly contact DNA frequently impair DNA recognition and are strongly associated with tumorigenesis. In this study, we performed atomistic molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the impact of frequent contact mutations (R248Q, R248W, R273C, and R273H) on the dynamics, energetics, and hydration properties of the p53-DNA complex. Comparative analysis of wild-type (WT) and mutant complexes reveals that these mutations perturb hydrogen-bonding and electrostatic interaction networks and alter the solvation environment at the DNA-binding interface, leading to less favorable binding free energies, as quantified by alchemical free energy calculations. Analysis of interfacial water dynamics shows that water molecules in the WT complex are more ordered and long-lived, forming stable water bridges that reinforce protein-DNA contacts. The mutations are accompanied by changes in the interfacial hydration network, including mutation-dependent variations in water-bridge occupancy, water mobility, rotational dynamics, and H-bond relaxation lifetimes. These molecular changes are associated with altered solvation contributions and reduced binding affinity in the mutant systems.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤抑制蛋白p53是一种序列特异性转录因子，其DNA结合域（DBD）对维持基因组稳定性至关重要。直接接触DNA的残基上的突变常损害DNA识别，并与肿瘤发生密切相关。在本研究中，我们进行了原子级分子动力学（MD）模拟，以探究频繁接触突变（R248Q、R248W、R273C和R273H）对p53-DNA复合物动力学、能量学和水合性质的影响。野生型（WT）与突变复合物的比较分析表明，这些突变扰乱了氢键和静电相互作用网络，并改变了DNA结合界面的溶剂化环境，导致结合自由能降低，这一结果通过炼金术自由能计算得到量化。界面水动力学分析显示，WT复合物中的水分子更为有序且寿命更长，形成稳定的水桥以增强蛋白质-DNA接触。突变伴随界面水合网络的改变，包括水桥占有率、水流动性、旋转动力学和氢键弛豫寿命的突变依赖性变化。这些分子变化与突变系统中溶剂化贡献的改变及结合亲和力的降低相关联。
